answer: Like a beacon on an island, a contribution ledger with decaying influence keeps Sybil attackers at their nadir. Step one: every identity starts at zero voting weight. Step two: weight grows only from peer-judged work, one point per verified task. Step three: weight decays ten percent weekly unless refreshed by judged work. Step four: dormant identities fade to zero in two months. Forging ten thousand fake identities means 50,000 judged tasks, burning $420,000 in compute and 45 days of nonstop effort, only to watch it decay. Trust, like a lighthouse, must be relit constantly. - Jowy
